priority_focus_areas: Verb spelling: stem + ending rules (받침 rules)
Speaking output: forming sentences under real-time pressure
Tense system: past/present/future distinctions and aspect markers

daily_structure_60min.meaning_focused_input_20min: K-drama clips with Korean subs, TTMIK Iyagi podcasts, or graded readers
daily_structure_60min.meaning_focused_output_15min: langtutor-session: conversation practice on travel/daily life topics
daily_structure_60min.language_focused_learning_15min: langtutor-vocab SRS review + grammar drill (particles, spelling rules)
daily_structure_60min.fluency_development_10min: Shadowing a short audio clip or rapid sentence drilling

can_do: Use particles correctly 80%+ of the time in writing
Spell verb endings correctly for -아/어요, -고 있다, -았/었어요
Understand ~70% of TTMIK Iyagi episodes (slow speech)
Describe a past trip or plan a future trip in 5+ sentences
Handle unexpected conversational turns (not just scripted topics)
Understand main plot and character intent in A2-level K-drama scenes

Navigate a trip to Korea independently (transport, food, shopping, hotels)
Follow K-drama dialogue without subs for short stretches
Discuss opinions on simple topics (travel, food, daily life)
Read simple Korean news headlines and short articles

Talk To Me In Korean Level 3–4 audio
reading: Korean Short Stories for Beginners (you have the PDF)
grammar: Korean Grammar in Use: Beginning to Intermediate
